The original rectangular block has dimensions \(12\times 8\times 6\).

### 1. Original surface area
\[
S_{\text{original}}
=2(12\cdot 8+12\cdot 6+8\cdot 6)
=2(96+72+48)
=432.
\]

### 2. Area removed from each \(12\times 8\) end
The cut-out is \(3\) units high because \(8-5=3\), and it is \(12-3=9\) units long. Thus, on each end, the removed area is
\[
9\cdot 3=27.
\]

The cut runs through the full depth of \(6\). On the four lateral faces, the new horizontal and vertical surfaces exactly replace the removed top and side surfaces, so their total area is unchanged.

Therefore, the total decrease in surface area is
\[
2\cdot 27=54.
\]

### 3. Percentage decrease
\[
\frac{54}{432}\cdot 100\%=\frac18\cdot100\%=12.5\%.
\]

\[
\boxed{\text{B: }12.5\%}
\]
